text:
每件道具都有重量，和它占几格是两回事：一卷丝绸占三格却轻飘飘，一块铁锭只占一格却压手。大致按材质：重型的最沉，金属其次，石头、晶体和盐块再次，木、骨、皮、布按格算，药、食物和小玩意最轻。负重只算{zone:棋盘}上的东西，包本身不算重；{zone:地上}、保险箱和仓库里的都不算。背包窗底下的负重签写着当前 / 上限，道具的悬浮窗上写着它有多重。

每个角色的负重上限不一样，擅长生存的最能扛；局外科技「扛重」能把上限往上推。超过上限就进入{b}吃力{/b}：出手变慢、耐力回得慢。再超出上限的四分之一是{b}超重{/b}：更慢、耐力回得更慢、耐力上限也降。超出上限一半就{b}寸步难行{/b}：超重的减益照旧，地图上每走一步（传送也算）倒计时扣双倍，原地等待不翻倍。负重从不直接降低伤害，砍下去还是那一刀。

texts.en:
Every item has a Weight, and that is separate from how many cells it takes up: a roll of silk fills three cells yet weighs next to nothing, while an iron ingot fills just one cell and is heavy. Roughly by material: heavy items weigh the most, then metal, then stone, crystal and salt; wood, bone, leather and cloth are counted per cell; medicine, food and trinkets are the lightest. Load counts only what is on the {zone:棋盘}; Bags themselves weigh nothing, and anything on the {zone:地上}, in the Safe or in the Warehouse doesn't count. The Load wax seal at the bottom of the pack window shows current / limit, and each item's tooltip shows its Weight.

Each character has a different Load limit: the survivor carries the most. The Hauling upgrade, earned outside runs, raises the limit. Go over the limit and you are {b}Burdened{/b}: you act more slowly and Stamina recovers more slowly. Go a quarter past the limit and you are {b}Overloaded{/b}: you are even slower, Stamina recovers even more slowly, and your max Stamina drops. Go half past the limit and you are {b}Immobile{/b}: the Overloaded debuffs still apply, and every step on the map (teleporting included) costs double Countdown, while waiting in place is not doubled. Load never lowers your damage directly; a swing still hits just as hard.
